Hello

About me

Hello! My name is Nardine Nader, I’m a Cairo-based engine and tools programmer. I started in game design and Unity, but over time I became more interested in what sits underneath the editor: graphics APIs, engine internals, rendering, and the tools that help teams build and test their games. I believe that to use an engine fluently, you need to understand it natively — not just how to operate its interface, but how it was built and why it works the way it does. That understanding lets you work with the engine rather than against it, and gives you the foundation to build better tools around it.

Right now, I write C++ and Blueprint tools on both Unreal Engine and Unity, working on Arabic localization and RTL UI problems. My experience spans across two industries: VFX and games. Along the way, I’ve worked across design, shaders, tools, localization, and engine-level programming. And I’m always interested in going one layer deeper — from using the engine, to understanding it, to eventually building the tools and systems that make it better.

My journey

  1. Jan 2026 to now

    Game Engine Tools Developer (C++ / UE5), Sahure Labs

    Remote from Cairo for a studio in Malaga, Spain.

    • Designed and built SNOOP, a game-agnostic UI localization QA pipeline for Unreal Engine 5 and Unity. It records UI sessions in English, turns them into structured navigation paths, replays them in Arabic and certifies widget states across locales.
    • Built the UE5 C++ plugin and validated it on Epic's Lyra Starter Game. Ported the core system to Unity (C#) and validated it on a shipped educational game, where a replay run certified 42 of 43 sessions with no foreign-screen navigation failures.
    • Rewrote click attribution to use Slate's native hit-testing instead of rect containment, and fixed navigation hash collisions with an occurrence-index scheme. A known-good baseline run catches regressions.
    • Serialized live UI state to JSON (text, bounding boxes, hierarchy) with the UI Snapshot Engine, and built an OCR tool that finds text overflow, clipping and alignment defects in Arabic layouts.
    • Architected a real-time voice intelligence system on the ODIN voice SDK (Arabic speech recognition, moderation, analytics) and wrote the technical plan for leadership. Built the audio capture pipeline and a native UE5 C++ client.
  2. Oct 2024 to Oct 2025

    ITI, CG Technical Director track

    A professional training program of 40 credit hours. We learned each craft first, then how to build tools for it:

    • Rigging in Maya, then rigging scripting in MEL.
    • Unreal Engine art, then Unreal editor tools.
    • Houdini for procedural and VFX work.
    • Machine learning and computer vision courses, alongside the core coding stack: OOP, data structures and algorithms.
    • Graduation project: a Vulkan graphics engine (Fleura). I built its shader system for materials, lights and texture/UV mapping in GLSL and C++, with a basic Qt interface.
  3. Sep 2020 to Jun 2024

    BSc Computer & Information Sciences, Ain Shams University

    A dual degree with the University of East London and a minor in Digital Multimedia. My graduation project, Chemverse, a VR chemistry lab in Unity, earned Distinction with Honour.

  4. Jun to Nov 2023

    Game Designer Intern, GMIND

    A remote internship with a team in Alexandria. I built gameplay features, cutscenes and level logic in Unity (C#) for narrative-driven levels.
